forum.you_won_sub: Congratulations — you won {prize}. Claim it so the host knows to send it your way.

form.description_placeholder: Rules, eligibility, how the prize is delivered…
form.rules_placeholder: Who may enter, how and when winners are selected, the entry deadline, how winners are contacted, odds of winning, sponsor details…
form.rules_help: Shown in full on the giveaway's page, in its own section, formatted like a post. Use this where your local rules have to be published.
form.skill_answer_help: Where a pure game of chance isn't allowed, the drawn winner must answer this correctly before they can claim the prize — entering stays one click. Case, spaces and thousands separators are ignored.
form.skill_attempts_help: How many wrong answers the winner may give before the prize is redrawn for the next entrant the draw seed picks. 0 lets them keep trying, and nothing is ever redrawn.
form.claim_placeholder: e.g. DM me your shipping address or email to receive your prize.
form.claim_help: Shown to every winner after they claim, so they know how to receive the prize.
form.claim_lines_help: One line per winner, in draw order: winner #1 gets line 1, winner #2 line 2, and so on. Each winner sees only their own line, after claiming. Winners beyond the last line get only the instructions above.
form.composer_help: Saved as a draft only you can see. It goes public when you post this — saving the post as a draft keeps it a draft too.
form.post_bonus_help: One-time bonus granted when an entrant posts anywhere in the community.

admin.advent_jokers_help: How many missed doors each member can still open late, with a joker (0 to 3). A door opened with a joker counts as a ticket for the grand prize, but its own draw has already run.

admin.show_nav_setting: Show a "Giveaways" link in the main navigation
admin.sponsor_retention_help: How long after a giveaway or calendar ends members' agreements to share their email address with its sponsor are kept, from 0 to 365. 0 erases them as soon as it ends.
